subject: comb jelly
title: Cut Two Comb Jellies and 9 Times in 10 They Become One Animal

scenes.text: One comb jelly had two mouths. Nobody knew why.
It was bigger than the others, with two rear ends too.
So scientists cut pieces off other comb jellies and set them side by side.
Nine out of ten pairs joined into a single animal.
Within two hours, ninety-five percent of their muscle movements were in sync. Poke one side, the whole body flinched.
Food from one mouth flowed through both guts. That two-mouthed jelly was two animals.

description:
A comb jelly found with two mouths turned out to be two animals that had merged.
In a 2024 Current Biology study, 9 of 10 injured pairs fused, and within about two hours 95% of their muscle contractions were synchronised, with food passing through a shared gut.
What other animal could pull this off?
first_comment: The fused jellies lived for at least three weeks. If two animals share one body and one nervous system, is it still two animals?
